test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the Global Wind Energy Council, what is India's worldwide rank in terms of installed wind energy capacity as of the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **Fourth.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **India is fourth on the list of countries with the highest wind energy capacity, with all of its near 39 GW located onshore**.
 
• **The country currently has no installed offshore capacity, although has outlined targets to deploy 5 GW by 2022 and 30 GW by 2030**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Global Wind Energy Council

 
• It was** established in 2005 to provide a credible and representative forum for the entire wind energy sector at an international level**.
 
• **China is the world leader in wind energy 288.32 GW.**
 
• **National Institute of Wind Energy (NIWE) established in Chennai in 1998 by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India is an autonomous research and development institution.**
